claims: No. 3 seed Arkansas defeated No. 4 seed Vanderbilt 86-75 in the 2026 SEC Men's Basketball Tournament championship game.
The 2026 SEC Men's Basketball Tournament championship game was on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 2026 SEC Men's Basketball Tournament championship game was in Nashville, Tennessee.
Arkansas Razorbacks won the 2026 SEC Tournament Championship with a record of 26-8.
Vanderbilt Commodores were runner-up in the 2026 SEC Tournament Championship with a record of 26-8.
Final score of the 2026 SEC Tournament Championship game was Arkansas 86, Vanderbilt 75.
The 2026 SEC Tournament Championship was at Bridgestone Arena, Nashville, Tennessee.
Darius Acuff Jr. was the 2026 SEC Tournament MVP.
Darius Acuff Jr. had 28 points in the 2026 SEC Tournament final.
Darius Acuff Jr. had 11 assists in the 2026 SEC Tournament final.
Arkansas secured their first SEC Tournament championship since 2000.
Arkansas Razorbacks notes that coach John Calipari secured his first SEC title since 2018 in his second season with the Razorbacks.
According to The Vanderbilt Hustler, the 2026 SEC Men's Basketball Tournament championship game featured 12 lead changes.
According to The Vanderbilt Hustler, the 2026 SEC Men's Basketball Tournament championship game featured five ties.
According to The Vanderbilt Hustler, Arkansas pulled away in the final minutes of the 2026 SEC Men's Basketball Tournament championship game.
